newsitem.title: USA: American Health Properties names chairman.
newsitem.headline: American Health Properties names chairman.

text.p: American Health Properties Inc said on Monday it named Joseph Sullivan to the additional position of chairman.
Sullivan, who joined the company in 1993, will continue to serve as president and chief executive.
He takes over from Sheldon King, who was elected in July to serve as interim chairman after Walter McNerney was sidelined by health problems.
Both King and McNerney remain members of the board of American Health Properties, a real estate investment trust specializing in heath care.
